rounds: Scope and privacy: native sender authorization, metadata projection, observer-only listeners, session retention and manifest permissions; blocking/userscript implementations are unchanged.
Lifecycle and cost: async disconnects, write ordering and failures, entry/byte/connection/queue limits; preserve table nodes and accessibility notice when polling unchanged data.
Rendered output and consumers: desktop/narrow themes, full sidebar links, keyboard details/export, native stop/clear/tab/owner behavior, final source hashes and documentation limits.
